files.description: Water gauge log (120 rows): gauge (gauge name such as "LA-01"), reading (meters, three decimals; about 3% empty), level (alert level, whole number from 3 to 80, no empty cells), site (dam, canal or lake; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent).

task_text: The display can only show alert levels up to 50, so any level above 50 is shown as 50. Apply that limit and return the gauge log as a table with the columns gauge, site (in lower case without extra spaces) and level, in file order.
intended_computation: Cap level at 50 (41 rows are higher), clean site and return gauge, site and level for all 120 rows in file order.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the capped values written through a separate column variable never reach the table

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
